title: Authenticate and reach the mail experience
description: This verifies that a user can sign in and land in the authenticated mail experience.

steps.description: Navigate to /sign-in
Fill in {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill in {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the sign-in form
Verify the authenticated mail experience is displayed

title: Open the inbox after linking a Google account
description: This verifies that a signed-in user with a linked inbox can return to the app and see syncing start in the inbox experience.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to connect a Google account
Complete the account linking flow
Return to the app
Verify the inbox sync state is displayed
Verify the mail experience is available

title: Protect the mail experience from unauthenticated access
description: This verifies that an unauthenticated visitor is redirected to sign in when trying to access the protected mail area.

steps.description: Navigate to /mail
Verify the sign-in experience is displayed

title: Show the onboarding state for a signed-in user without a linked inbox
description: This verifies that a signed-in user who has not linked a Google inbox sees the onboarding prompt instead of the mail client.

steps.description: Navigate to /sign-in
Fill in {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill in {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /
Verify the account linking prompt is displayed

title: Compose a new email and send it successfully
description: An authenticated user with a linked inbox can open a new draft, fill in the message details, send it, and see the sent confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill in {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the sign-in form
Open the mail client
Open a new email draft
Fill in a recipient into the recipients field
Fill in a subject into the subject field
Fill in a message body into the email editor
Send the email
Verify a sent confirmation is visible
Verify the draft is cleared or closed

title: Open and read an email thread
description: This verifies that a linked user can select a thread and read its message content in the reading pane.

steps.description: Navigate to /sign-in
Fill in {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill in {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /mail
Select an email thread from the thread list
Verify the selected thread is displayed in the reading pane
Verify message content is displayed

title: Browse folders in the three-pane inbox
description: This verifies that a linked user can open the mail dashboard and switch between mailbox folders in the three-pane layout.

steps.description: Navigate to /sign-in
Fill in {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill in {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /mail
Click the folder or mailbox navigation control
Verify the three-pane inbox layout is displayed
Verify mailbox threads are displayed

title: Search finds matching emails
description: This verifies that a user can search synced mail and see matching email results.

steps.description: Navigate to /mail
Focus the search input
Type a search query into the search field
Verify matching search results are displayed

title: Reply to an existing thread and send the response
description: An authenticated user with a linked inbox can open a thread, reveal the reply editor, send a reply, and return to the thread view with the response added.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill in {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the sign-in form
Open the mail client
Open an email thread
Open the reply editor
Fill in a reply message into the email editor
Send the response
Verify a sent confirmation is visible
Verify the reply appears in the thread

title: Search synced mail and return to the normal thread list
description: This verifies that a user can search synced email, open a matching thread, clear the search, and return to the normal thread list.

steps.description: Navigate to /sign-in
Fill in {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill in {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /mail
Fill in a search term that matches a synced email into the mail search field
Select a matching thread from the search results
Clear the search field
Verify the normal thread list is displayed
Verify the selected thread can be browsed in the inbox experience

title: Account switching updates the inbox view
description: This verifies that a user can switch between linked accounts and see the thread list refresh for the newly selected inbox.

steps.description: Navigate to /mail
Open the account switcher
Select a different linked account
Verify the thread list updates for the selected account

title: Mark a thread as done and move it back to inbox
description: This verifies that a user can toggle a thread between done and inbox states from the mail dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /sign-in
Fill in {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill in {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /mail
Select an email thread from the thread list
Toggle the thread to the done state
Toggle the thread back to the inbox state
Verify the thread remains available in the inbox experience

title: Search can be cleared to return to the inbox list
description: This verifies that clearing an active search returns the user to the normal thread list.

steps.description: Navigate to /mail
Focus the search input
Type a search query into the search field
Clear the search field
Verify the normal thread list is displayed

title: Use AI assistance to draft a new email
description: An authenticated user with a linked inbox can open a draft, request AI help, review the generated text, and send the email successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill in {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the sign-in form
Open the mail client
Open a new email draft
Request AI assistance for the draft
Review the suggested draft content
Send the email
Verify a sent confirmation is visible
Verify the AI-generated content was used in the draft

title: Keyboard shortcut opens search
description: This verifies that the search interface can be opened with the keyboard shortcut and used to review results.

steps.description: Navigate to /mail
Press the keyboard shortcut to open search
Type a search query into the search field
Verify matching search results are displayed

title: Start the upgrade checkout flow
description: An authenticated user can open billing and start an upgrade checkout from the app.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill in {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the sign-in form
Open the mail client
Open the billing or plan section
Start the upgrade process
Verify the checkout flow is started
Verify an upgrade path is presented

title: Ask AI suggested prompt returns a response
description: This verifies that a user can open Ask AI, choose a suggested prompt, and read a streamed answer based on email context.

steps.description: Navigate to /mail
Open the Ask AI panel
Choose a suggested prompt
Verify an AI response is displayed

title: Ask AI accepts a custom question
description: This verifies that a user can ask a custom question in Ask AI and receive a streamed response.

steps.description: Navigate to /mail
Open the Ask AI panel
Type a custom question into the chat input
Submit the question
Verify an AI response is displayed

title: Collapse and expand the sidebar
description: This verifies that a user can collapse the mail sidebar and expand it again without leaving the inbox.

steps.description: Navigate to /sign-in
Fill in {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill in {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the sign-in form
Navigate to /mail
Collapse the sidebar
Expand the sidebar
Verify the sidebar navigation is displayed

title: View current subscription plan and usage limits
description: An authenticated user can open the billing section and see their current subscription status and usage information.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill in {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the sign-in form
Open the mail client
Open the billing or plan section
Verify the current subscription status is visible
Verify usage limits are displayed

title: Switch between light and dark themes
description: An authenticated user can toggle the interface theme and see the appearance change in the mail client.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill in {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the sign-in form
Open the mail client
Toggle the theme setting
Toggle the theme setting again
Verify the interface appearance changes between themes
Verify the selected theme persists within the session

title: Ask AI shows the quota notice after repeated use
description: This verifies that a user sees the daily limit notice after exceeding the free Ask AI quota.

steps.description: Navigate to /mail
Open the Ask AI panel
Submit repeated questions until the free quota is exceeded
Verify a daily limit notice is displayed
